templates.name: Adobe Stock 32-Icon Grid (8x4 Master Prompt)
templates.description: Exact commercial standard: 8x4 Grid layout, clean vector outline & solid silhouette fill on pure white background.
templates.outlineTemplate: A clean, professional icon set featuring 32 line art icons based on the theme of {{THEME}}. The icons are arranged in a perfectly aligned grid layout (8 columns × 4 rows), with equal spacing between each icon. Each icon is centered within its own identical square bounding box, maintaining consistent padding, proportions and visual balance. Style: line art, minimal, modern, professional vector-style icons. Consistent medium stroke weight across all icons, with refined and clean line quality. Open lines, smooth curves, clean geometric construction and balanced negative space. Composition: pixel-perfect 8 × 4 grid system, mathematically equal spacing, consistent margins on all sides. Design rules: pure black outlines only, no color fills, no solid fills, no gradients, no shadows, no textures, no 3D effects. Background: pure white background, clean and isolated. Rendering: flat vector-style appearance, clean geometric shapes, crisp edges, minimal anchor complexity, optimized for scalability and easy vectorization. Quality: ultra sharp, high resolution, crisp lines, no distortion, professional commercial stock quality.
